The new `_from_xarray` unconditionally attempts to unflatten snapshot coordinates whenever the component has a network, without checking linopy semantics or the snapshot-index option. For an array with a flat, tuple-valued snapshot index and suitable auxiliary coordinates, it now reconstructs a MultiIndex before conversion to pandas, whereas the base implementation leaves that index flat. Thus the same input can produce a different result even under legacy semantics with the default, `"auto"`, or `"multiindex"` setting.
